messages.subject: Executive Leadership Profile | GCC Government Relations, ESG & Country Strategy
messages.body:
Dear SEEKERS Executive Search Team,

I am contacting you through your current executive-search address after an earlier message to the obsolete seekersme.com domain failed at DNS level.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My leadership scope covers ESG and sustainability, external and corporate affairs, government and regulatory relations, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships, executive advisory and country-facing coordination within a major international mining operation.

I work directly across ministries, regulators, public institutions, communities, industry bodies and senior corporate leadership, coordinating complex matters involving regulatory approvals, stakeholder commitments, reputation, social performance, sustainability and cross-functional operating teams.

I am exploring senior mandates across Saudi Arabia, the UAE and the wider GCC, including Country Director or Representative, Executive Director, Director or Head of Government Relations, Corporate Affairs, ESG and Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships, External Affairs, Stakeholder Engagement and Country Operations. I am internationally mobile and available on 30 days' notice.

My current GCC executive CV is attached for your review. I would welcome consideration for current or upcoming executive searches aligned with this profile.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director | ESG | Corporate Affairs | Government Relations
